meta.description: Maritime oil & gas flow disruption incidents across four strategic chokepoints. Seeded from Reuters, Bloomberg, S&P Global, CNBC, Wikipedia, and other public reporting. Auto-updates via CENTCOM RSS.

incidents.event: US/Israel strikes on Iran; IRGC declares Strait of Hormuz closed to all foreign shipping
incidents.details: Following the killing of Supreme Leader Khamenei, Iran's IRGC broadcasts 'no ship is allowed to pass.' Immediate flight of shipping; vessels stay in port or reverse course.
incidents.flow_impact: ~20–25% of world seaborne oil and ~20% of world LNG immediately suspended; pre-war ~130 transits/day drops to near zero

incidents.location: Off Muscat / Ras Al Khaimah / Kumzar
incidents.event: 3 vessels struck in a single day — signals sustained campaign, not isolated incident
incidents.details: Crude tanker MKD Vyom hit by projectile (1 crew killed); bunkering tanker Hercules Star struck (fire, crew evacuates); sanctioned tanker Skylight evacuated off Kumzar.
incidents.flow_impact: 3 simultaneous hits confirm a sustained blockade campaign; war-risk insurers begin withdrawing Gulf coverage

incidents.event: US-flagged products tanker struck by two projectiles; fire breaks out, crew evacuates
incidents.details: First hit on a US-flagged vessel in the campaign. Bahrain port operations disrupted.
incidents.flow_impact: Bahrain port operations disrupted; US-flagged vessels now confirmed at risk alongside other flags

incidents.event: Crude tanker and bulker sustain minor damage 7–10 nm off Fujairah — early warning of terminal risk
incidents.details: Fujairah is the UAE's key bunkering/storage hub and a critical chokepoint for insurance and physical operations.
incidents.flow_impact: Early signal that the Fujairah hub is within attack range; terminal closure risk priced into insurance

incidents.vessel: Safeen Prestige (+ salvage tugboat hit 2 days later)
incidents.event: Container ship hit and abandoned; salvage tugboat assisting it struck separately
incidents.details: Rescue and salvage operations themselves become targets — significantly widens the risk profile for all vessels and emergency responders in the area.
incidents.flow_impact: Chilling effect on rescue/salvage; insurance war-risk exclusions expand to cover salvage operations

incidents.event: Crude tanker hit at anchor by Iranian remote-controlled explosive boat — first hit on Iraqi loading infrastructure
incidents.details: Khor al-Zubair serves Iraq's northern port oil loading operations. First direct attack on Iraqi crude-loading infrastructure.
incidents.flow_impact: Iraq's crude-loading infrastructure directly threatened; ~3.4 mbd pre-war seaborne export capacity at risk

incidents.event: Terminal suspends flows entirely; Brent futures spike intraday toward $120/bbl
incidents.details: ~17 million bpd less crude/products departing Persian Gulf that week (S&P Global CERA estimate). Kuwait and Iraq begin shut-ins as storage nears capacity.
incidents.flow_impact: ~17 mbd Gulf crude/products disrupted; Kuwait and Iraq begin shut-ins; IEA begins coordinating emergency stock release; Brent approaches $120

incidents.vessel: Mayuree Naree; One Majesty; Star Gwyneth; Safesea Vishnu; Zefyros
incidents.event: 5 vessels hit in one day; Safesea Vishnu and Zefyros attacks force complete halt of Iraq's oil ports
incidents.details: A crew body recovered from the water. Iraq's entire seaborne crude export capacity (~3.4 mbd pre-war) goes offline — even if briefly.
incidents.flow_impact: Iraq's ~3.4 mbd seaborne crude export capacity entirely offline; worst single-day attack count of the campaign

incidents.event: Iran's new Supreme Leader declares Hormuz will remain closed; Brent holds above $100
incidents.details: Blockade removes ~20% of global oil trade. Gulf producers cut output by ~10 mbd combined. Storage capacity reaches 'critical limits.'
incidents.flow_impact: ~20% of global oil trade removed; 10 mbd Gulf producer output cut; storage at critical limits; Brent above $100

incidents.vessel: Fujairah terminal (2nd hit in 3 days); Kharg Island export hub
incidents.event: Second drone attack on Fujairah in 3 days; US strikes Iran's Kharg Island oil export hub; IEA releases record 400M-barrel emergency reserves
incidents.details: IEA coordinates a record 400-million-barrel emergency reserve release. Kharg Island handles ~90% of Iran's oil exports.
incidents.flow_impact: IEA 400M-barrel emergency reserve release (record); Kharg Island (Iran's primary crude export hub) struck by US

incidents.event: Kuwait-flagged LPG tanker struck at anchor — first gas carrier hit in the campaign
incidents.details: First direct hit on an LPG (liquefied petroleum gas) carrier. Widens disruption from crude oil into the gas trade.
incidents.flow_impact: Campaign now spans crude oil AND LPG/gas tankers; broader gas supply chain at risk

incidents.event: Iranian aerial attacks cause 'extensive damage' to Ras Laffan — world's largest gas plant and Qatar's main LNG export hub
incidents.details: Qatar is the world's 2nd/3rd largest LNG exporter. Ras Laffan handles ~77 mtpa of LNG and is the world's single largest gas processing and liquefaction facility.
incidents.flow_impact: Direct threat to ~20% of world LNG supply; Qatar's entire LNG export capacity at risk

incidents.event: Fully loaded Kuwaiti crude tanker hit at anchorage; hull damage, no spill
incidents.details: Confirms attacks continuing a full month into the war with no abatement.
incidents.flow_impact: Sustained blockade campaign confirmed into late March — no abatement after one month of war

incidents.event: US imposes formal naval blockade on Iranian ports (13 Apr – 29 May); Iran covertly exports ~1.5 mbd via shadow fleet
incidents.details: US naval blockade of Iranian ports adds a counter-layer. Iran continues exporting an estimated ~1.5 mbd covertly despite the blockade.
incidents.flow_impact: US counter-blockade on Iran; covert shadow-fleet exports continue at ~1.5 mbd; Hormuz standoff stabilises at very low traffic levels

incidents.event: US–Iran MOU signed; Hormuz lanes promised open — brief cautious traffic rebound
incidents.details: US and Iran sign a memorandum of understanding for reopening Hormuz. Tehran promises safe passage but lanes are not clearly defined. Brief traffic rebound as shippers cautiously test the route.
incidents.flow_impact: Partial short-lived traffic rebound; no full restoration — MOU collapses within 3 weeks as attacks resume

incidents.event: At least 9 ships attacked since July 6; Iran forces vessels into territorial waters; MOU effectively collapses
incidents.details: Maritime risk firms describe return to 'worst case scenario.' US launches 6 rounds of retaliatory airstrikes. AIS data shows no vessel >10,000 dwt on the southern highway after July 7.
incidents.flow_impact: Full blockade conditions restored; southern highway halted for vessels >10,000 dwt; MOU collapses

incidents.event: 13 consecutive nights of US strikes on Iran; Brent surges above $100 briefly (+14% week-on-week); Iran retaliates against US bases in Bahrain, Kuwait, Jordan
incidents.details: US strikes Iran for 13 straight nights, hits a tanker attempting to evade blockade en route to Kharg Island. Iran retaliates against US forward bases across the Gulf.
incidents.flow_impact: Brent +14% week-on-week; briefly above $100; US Gulf bases under Iranian missile fire for first time

incidents.event: Houthis reactivate Red Sea threat in solidarity with Iran following start of US–Israel war
incidents.details: Houthis resume attacks on Israel-linked shipping. Red Sea threat formally reactivated as war opens on the Hormuz front simultaneously.
incidents.flow_impact: War-risk insurance for Red Sea transits begins climbing again; operators accelerate Cape of Good Hope diversion

incidents.event: Houthis threaten to resume targeting Israeli-linked ships; IRGC issues supporting warning; insurance premiums spike on threat alone
incidents.details: Houthis threaten to resume targeting Israeli-linked ships. IRGC Quds Force commander issues a supporting warning. Insurance premiums for Red Sea transits begin climbing again on threat alone.
incidents.flow_impact: Insurance premiums spike on threat alone; operators continue Cape route diversion; Saudi Arabia routes more crude via Red Sea as Hormuz workaround

incidents.event: Houthis strike 2 Saudi tankers; declare naval blockade on Saudi crude — Brent jumps 6.96% to $100.65/bbl
incidents.details: Saudi Arabia had been routing crude via the Red Sea as its Hormuz workaround. This simultaneous closure of the backup route sends Brent through $100.
incidents.flow_impact: Saudi Red Sea workaround closed; both primary (Hormuz) and backup (Red Sea) routes blocked simultaneously; Brent +6.96% to $100.65

incidents.event: Trump warns of 'major military punishment' against Iran/Houthis; Brent eases below $98 but still +12% week-on-week
incidents.details: Trump threatens 'massive attack' on Iran. Brent eases slightly to below $98 but remains +12% week-on-week as market prices in compounding three-front risk.
incidents.flow_impact: Brent -2% on warning but still +12% week-on-week; three-front disruption (Hormuz + Red Sea + Black Sea) fully priced in

incidents.event: Ukraine strikes 15 ships overnight; 8-day Azov tally reaches 105+ vessels; Russia restricts Azov shipping
incidents.details: Sustained pressure forces Russia to formally restrict shipping through Azov, a route carrying ~25% of Russian grain exports and significant shadow-fleet oil.
incidents.flow_impact: Azov shipping formally restricted; ~25% of Russian grain exports disrupted; Russian shadow-fleet oil tankers under sustained attack

incidents.event: Ukraine drone commander declares 'first Azov round complete' and expands campaign into Black Sea proper
incidents.details: Campaign broadens from a regional (Azov) to a strategic (open Black Sea) oil/gas disruption effort — significantly raising the volume of traffic at risk.
incidents.flow_impact: Black Sea campaign formally opens beyond Azov; oil and gas tankers across the wider Black Sea now targeted

incidents.vessel: 11 Russian vessels (5 oil tankers, 1 gas tanker, 3 dry cargo, 2 tugs)
incidents.event: Coordinated cross-sea strikes on 11 Russian vessels; global wheat/grain prices jump
incidents.details: Ukraine says it hit 11 Russian vessels while Russia targets Ukrainian maritime assets. Wheat/grain prices jump globally on shipping-route fears; Azov shipping stays restricted.
incidents.flow_impact: Global grain prices rise; Azov restricted; oil/gas exports continue under attack; Black Sea campaign fully established

incidents.event: Drone strikes on 2 tankers loading Kazakh crude at CPC Novorossiysk terminal; loading suspended — suspends ~80% of Kazakhstan's export route
incidents.details: Fires break out and are extinguished; CPC's SPM-1 & SPM-3 moorings reported undamaged. Loading of ~80% of Kazakhstan's crude export route suspended pending assessment. 5th attack on CPC facilities.
incidents.flow_impact: ~80% of Kazakhstan's crude exports (~1.5 mbd, ≈1% of global oil supply) suspended; CPC loading halted pending assessment

incidents.event: 4th CPC tanker attack in 4 consecutive days; Kazakhstan formally protests — calls strikes 'attacks on neutral vessels'
incidents.details: Nelsa hit while loading Rosneft Urals crude originating in Kazakhstan. Loading briefly resumed then suspended again. Kazakhstan formally protests, calling the strikes attacks on 'peaceful shipment of US- and Kazakh-owned crude aboard neutral vessels.'
incidents.flow_impact: CPC loading suspension deepens; BTC Middle Corridor (Azerbaijan/Georgia/Turkey) activated as partial workaround

incidents.event: Empty tanker en route to load Kazakh crude hit by drone — 4 strikes in 4 consecutive days confirmed
incidents.details: Fire extinguished, no casualties. Confirms 4 strikes in 4 days on the CPC supply chain. Deters tankers from even approaching the terminal, compounding the loading suspension.
incidents.flow_impact: Approach deterrence compounding loading halt; tankers no longer willing to approach terminal even empty

incidents.event: 5+ CPC tanker attacks in July; Kazakhstan cuts oil production; BTC Middle Corridor scale-up begins
incidents.details: Moscow Times/Reuters confirm at least 5 tankers attacked at the CPC terminal in July alone. Kazakhstan cuts oil production again. Analysts flag Kazakhstan's near-total dependence on a single export artery through an active war zone as a 'critical strategic vulnerability.'
incidents.flow_impact: Kazakhstan cuts output; BTC Middle Corridor being scaled as structural alternative but cannot absorb full CPC volume

incidents.vessel: 150+ cumulative across all Black Sea / Azov actions
incidents.event: Ukraine tally reaches 150+ vessels attacked since campaign intensified; three-front disruption (Hormuz + Red Sea + Black Sea) drives Brent +30% for July, briefly above $100
incidents.details: Oil markets now managing simultaneous disruption on three fronts. Brent +30% for July, briefly above $100. Historically a single-chokepoint disruption nudged Brent 1–4%; this overlap pushed it through $100.
incidents.flow_impact: Three-front simultaneous disruption fully priced into markets; Brent +30% for July; shadow fleet severely constrained
